conversations.title: Hospital cash for an adult: both times in one message, a rate row with a yearly cap

turns.user: Grace got warded on 14 September 2026 at 9.50pm and went home on 18 September 2026 at 8.20am. What does CareDay give her in hospital cash for that stay?
turns.visible:
For Grace, CareDay’s “Hospital cash (each complete 24 hours, max 90 per year)” is S$100 per complete 24 hours for an insured adult, and the indicative estimate for her stated stay is S$300, based on three complete 24-hour periods, assuming at least 3 of the 90 complete 24-hour periods are still available this year.
The policy counts complete 24-hour periods from admission and excludes any shorter period; admission and discharge times are taken from the hospital discharge summary.
